work.awaiting.hint: Only a person can clear this. What you choose is written on the record, and the note is what whoever reads it later has to go on.
work.awaiting.finishQuest: Finishing ends this session. Its quest #{{quest}} stays as it is unless you mark it done now.
work.awaiting.questNote: your note on the quest (optional) — its record says you marked it done
work.awaiting.declinePlaceholder: the reason — the part whoever reads this record can act on
work.awaiting.answer: Answering it in the box below lets it carry on — that is a message, not one of these.
work.awaiting.answerPlaceholder: your answer — the same session goes on with these words
work.awaiting.answered: Answered — the same session goes on with your words at the driver's next look.
work.awaiting.goesOn: The same session goes on with this answer at the driver's next look.
work.awaiting.goAheadsLead: Answering one here answers this session too: the same session goes on with your answer at the driver's next look. Every session on the ask is handed it.
work.awaiting.goAheadApproved: Approved go-ahead #{{number}}; the same session goes on with it at the driver's next look.
work.awaiting.goAheadRefused: Refused go-ahead #{{number}}; the same session goes on with it at the driver's next look.
work.awaiting.goAheadNotWaiting: The session was no longer waiting on you, so the ask keeps your answer for every later start.
